baseline_reason: First release; input hashes provide geometry baseline
limitations: Original fixed appearance; skirt physics is authored for LOD0/1, LOD2/3 and hair/sleeves remain skeletal. Engine solver remains untested.
Native motion scans do not prove weapon grip, horse collision, IK, all intersections or body slider compatibility.
No facial animation or face/body customization support.
Unsimulated native-animation previews show reference leg/skirt intersections; authored cloth payload and capsule/travel screening do not certify dynamic collision.

cloth_validation.scope: Final payload structure and sampled native-animation capsule/travel screening; overlaps are skinning-reference measurements before the engine cloth solver
